text: {"schema_version":1,"verdict":"revise","checked":["intent_match","tradeoff_direction","knob_legality"],"critique":"Intent requires <=1.0 false alarms/hour. Proposed (transformer w3, q0.9, persistence 1) yields ~0.01/h at default replay, so OK. However threshold_q=0.9 is allowed but persistence=1 is allowed; window=3 allowed. Main issue: intent says “as fast as possible after onset” but persistence=1 is fastest; still, threshold_q=0.9 may be unnecessarily low vs q0.95/0.99—yet false-alarm budget is fine. No knob illegality; revise only if you want even earlier than q0.9 (not possible)."}
